title: Native shim drive-type control
condition: DriveTypeShimTests (Collection NativeVice): vice_drive_set_type sets Drive8Type and vice_drive_get_type reads it back; out-of-range units rejected; after set+reset the native drive PC lands in $8000-$FFFF for 32KB-ROM models (proves memiec re-init); vice_drivecpu_get_clk is monotonic under stepping; vice_drivecpu_execute_all callable; Drive8Type re-baselines to 1541 on the next machine create (no cross-test residue).
